comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 3a9441f and manuals/README.md. The driver is registered by the module's constructor, so it appears as soon as one of these is in the patch. MIDIOverAudioDriver::getInputDeviceName returns Port plus the device number. The lamp thresholds are isNear against -255.56 with tolerances of 0.44, 1.5 and 3 in src/modules/MIDIOverAudio/MIDIOverAudio.cpp. MIDI_MESSAGE_DATA_MAX_LENGTH is 3 in src/util/Drivers.hpp and the source carries a TODO about messages of other lengths. The trim knobs are excluded from randomisation.
